info.name: Task API
info.description: Requests for the Task API, including the cases the AI-generated checklist missed. Run top to bottom.

exec: pm.test('defaults', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.completed).to.eql(false); pm.expect(b.parent).to.eql(null); });
pm.test('title must not be empty', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.details).to.deep.include({field: 'title', issue: 'must not be empty'}));
pm.test('parsed', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.title).to.eql('Pay rent'); pm.expect(b.recurrence).to.eql('monthly'); pm.expect(b.due_date).to.match(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-01$/); });
pm.test('weekly high', () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.recurrence).to.eql('weekly'); pm.expect(b.priority).to.eql('high'); });
